info.name: Get partners with access to asset

params.name: business_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the requesting business.

params.name: asset_id
params.description: Unique identifier of a business asset.

params.name: start_index
params.description: An index to start fetching the results from. Only the results starting from this index will be returned.

params.name: bookmark
params.description: Cursor used to fetch the next page of items

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of items to include in a single page of the response. See documentation on Pagination for more information.

items.docs:
Get all the partners the requesting business has granted access to on the given asset.
Note: If the asset has been shared with you, an empty array will be returned. This is because an asset shared with
you cannot be shared with a different partner.

params.name: business_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the requesting business.

items.docs:
Grant multiple partners access to assets and/or update multiple partner's exisiting permissions to an asset.
If your partner already had permissions on the asset, they will be overriden with the new permissions you assign to them.
To learn more about permission levels, visit https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/business-manager-overview

Note: Not all listed permissions are applicable to each asset type. For example, PROFILE_PUBLISHER would not be
applicable to an asset of type AD_ACCO

params.name: business_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the requesting business.

items.docs:
Terminate multiple partners' access to an asset. If
- partner_type=INTERNAL: You will terminate a partner's asset access to your business assets.
- partner_type=EXTERNAL: You will terminate your own access to your partner's business assets.

info.name: Get assets assigned to a partner or assets assigned by a partner

params.name: business_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the requesting business.

params.name: partner_id
params.description: The partner id to be bound to the Business

params.name: partner_type
params.description:
Specifies whether to fetch internal or external (shared) partners. If partner_type=INTERNAL, the asset being queried is for accesses the partner has to your business assets.
If partner_type=EXTERNAL, the asset being queried is for the accesses you have to the partner's business asset.

params.name: asset_type
params.description: A resource type to filter the assets by. Only assets of the specified type will be returned.

params.name: start_index
params.description: An index to start fetching the results from. Only the results starting from this index will be returned.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of items to include in a single page of the response. See documentation on Pagination for more information.

params.name: bookmark
params.description: Cursor used to fetch the next page of items

items.docs:
Can be used to get the business assets your partner has granted you access to or the business assets you have
granted your partner access to. If you specify:
- partner_type=INTERNAL, you will retrieve your business assets that the partner has access to.
- partner_type=EXTERNAL, you will retrieve the partner's business assets that the partner has granted you access to.

params.name: business_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the requesting business.

params.name: assets_summary
params.description:
Include assets summary in the response if this is true.

The assets summary returns a dictionary representing a summary of the assets
for the business user ID, with information like the ad accounts and profiles
the user has permissions for and what those permissions are

params.name: partner_type
params.description:
Specifies whether to fetch internal or external (shared) partners. If partner_type=INTERNAL, the asset being queried is for accesses the partner has to your business assets.
If partner_type=EXTERNAL, the asset being queried is for the accesses you have to the partner's business asset.

params.name: partner_ids
params.description: A list of business partner ids separated by commas used to filter the results. Only partners with the specified ids will be returned.

params.name: start_index
params.description: An index to start fetching the results from. Only the results starting from this index will be returned.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of items to include in a single page of the response. See documentation on Pagination for more information.

params.name: bookmark
params.description: Cursor used to fetch the next page of items

items.docs:
Get all partners of the specified business.

If the assets_summary=TRUE and:
- partner_type=INTERNAL, the business assets returned are your business assets the partner has access to.
- partner_type=EXTERNAL, the business assets returned are your partner's business assets the partner has granted you
  access to.

params.name: business_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the requesting business.

items.docs:
Terminate partnerships between the specified partners and your business.
Note: You may only batch terminate partners of the same partner type.

params.name: bookmark

params.name: locale

params.name: limit
